item.title: NotePad++ Compare Plugin is back
item.author: emecas
item.description:
NotePad++ Compare Plugin
Compare plugin is back!
Announcement on the Notepad++ forum (2017): https://notepad-plus-plus.org/community/topic/12950/compare-plugin-is-back1
Archived copy (2019): https://web.archive.org/web/20190325045802/https://notepad-plus-plus.org/community/topic/12950/compare-plugin-is-back
pnedev, on the forum:

It’s been a year since I started working on fixing Compare plugin’s stability issues but because I like it a lot I got way further and did a serious code rework/refactoring and made many improvements/fixes. Now finally I’m pleased to announce the new ComparePlugin version 2.0.0.

Release 2.0.0: https://github.com/pnedev/comparePlus/releases/tag/v2.0.02
Repository: https://github.com/pnedev/comparePlus3
